description: This file defines the internal class ActivationRepartitioner, which is responsible for managing and facilitating the redistribution of grain activations among silos in an Orleans distributed system. It handles exchange requests, migration of grains, and communication with other silos to balance load and optimize processing. The class contains methods to initiate exchanges, accept exchange requests, compute candidate sets for migration, and finalize migration protocols, along with associated data structures like VertexEdge and CandidateVertex.

classes.name: ActivationRepartitioner
classes.description: Sealed internal class responsible for managing activation migration and load balancing across silos in Orleans, implementing logic for exchange requests, migration protocols, and communication with other silos.

classes.name: VertexEdge
classes.description: Record struct representing an edge/connection between two vertices (grains), including details such as migration status, silo partner, direction, and message weight.

classes.name: CandidateVertex
classes.description: Class representing a candidate grain for migration, including its Id, transfer score, and connected vertices.

classes.name: CandidateConnectedVertex
classes.description: Struct representing a connected vertex of a candidate, with target Id and transfer score.

methods.name: ActivationRepartitioner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repartitioner with dependencies and configuring internal state.

methods.name: OnActiveStart
methods.description: Method invoked when the silo becomes active to start periodic edge processing.

methods.name: ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets internal counters and data structures related to message sampling and migration scores.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the current total number of activations known to this silo.

methods.name: SetActivationCountOffset
methods.description: Sets an offset for the activation count, possibly for synchronization purposes.

methods.name: UpdateTimer
methods.description: Schedules the next exchange request timer based on configured period ranges.

methods.name: TriggerExchangeRequest
methods.description: Initiates an exchange request with other silos to balance load, considering cooldown and sampling enabled state.

methods.name: AcceptExchangeRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming exchange requests from other silos, deciding whether to accept and performing migration protocols.

methods.name: FinalizeProtocol
methods.description: Completes the migration process for grained IDs, updating activation directory and edge weights accordingly.

methods.name: CreateCandidateSets
methods.description: Creates sets of candidate silos with associated grains for potential migration, ordered by transfer score.

methods.name: GetCandidatesForSilo
methods.description: Derives a list of candidate grains for migration targeted at a specific silo based on edge scores.

methods.name: GetMigrationCandidates
methods.description: Returns local vertices identified as potential migration candidates.

methods.name: CreateLocalVertexEdges
methods.description: Generates the collection of local vertex edges with directional and weight info.
